verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated risk product that centralizes risk processes in one platform (vanta-docs-48) and automates reminders and workflows for regular assessment, which implies review cycles (vanta-docs-22). ISO 27001 AI templates also cover risks (vanta-docs-39). The evidence never describes how risks are structured, so most of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented risk scoring, treatment plans, per-risk owners, risk-to-control linkage, API access to risk records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
